Create a distinct composition centered on the action or emotional detail in THIS sentence; do not reproduce a generic two-cups-and-notebook table. For spoken abstract thoughts, illustrate the specific setting, relevant object, and relationship described, without adding plot events. Visual style: sophisticated 16-bit storybook pixel art, clearly visible carefully placed pixel clusters, dimensional amber light and cool blue shadows, walnut wood and moss-green textiles, tactile handmade objects, strong readable silhouette at phone size. Rich finished art, not vector icons and not photorealism. NO PEOPLE, NO HUMAN CHILDREN, NO HUMAN FACES, NO HUMANOIDS, NO FULL CHARACTERS. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT: never write the supplied narrative sentence, dialogue, letters, numbers, words, quotes, glyphs, signs, or decorative typography anywhere in the illustration. Narrative paper and notebooks show subtle ink-like marks ONLY, with no readable or invented characters. A spoken line is an art direction, NEVER lettering. For ritual words use unlettered warm wooden word tiles or a quiet reflection, NEVER invent a word. Single landscape image, full-bleed OPAQUE background with NO transparency, no split panels. FINAL HARD CONSTRAINT: depict objects and environment ONLY, never full characters, people, human faces, resident faces or written dialogue. The small elderly orange-gold fish PLUM is an explicit exception: include this fish when it is the named subject of the narrative, with a worried face and small notch in its fin.
